title: Evangelion: 1.11 You Are (Not) Alone

title_lang.zh_hk: 新世紀福音戰士新劇場版：序

synopsis: Scarred by the Second Impact, the Fourth Angel attacks Tokyo III and humanity's fate is left in Special Government Agency NERV's hands. Young Shinji Ikari is forced to pilot EVA-01. He and EVA-00 pilot Rei Ayanami are tasked to fight, but EVA-01 is damaged by the Sixth Angel. Misato Katsuragi draws up a plan to focus all of Japan's electricity into EVA-01's positron cannon to defeat the Angel.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 受到第二次衝擊的創傷之後，第4使徒攻擊了第3新東京市，人類的命運被交付到特務機關NERV手中。少年碇真嗣被迫駕駛EVA初號機，他和零號機駕駛員綾波麗一起負責作戰，但是EVA初號機受到第6使徒的破壞。葛城美里制定了一個計畫，將日本所有電力集中至EVA初號機的陽電子砲來擊敗使徒。
